# ORBITAL — 3D, motion & UI-decoration asset marketplace

> Browser-ready 3D, shader, motion and UI assets with performance budgets, machine-readable licences and a rate-limited agent API. Free read-only access for agents.

All endpoints are rate limited; read /docs/agent-rate-limits.md before bulk access. Free tier: search, metadata, licence, watermarked previews, install snippets. Paid file downloads require an entitlement.

## Catalogue
- [Catalogue JSON](https://orbital-assets-proxy.jc-bose.workers.dev/catalog.json): 8,647 rows with SPDX licence, SHA-256, source URL, R2 key
- [Category index](https://orbital-assets-proxy.jc-bose.workers.dev/catalog.md): 8 families, 66 subcategories
- [Format & performance spec](https://orbital-assets-proxy.jc-bose.workers.dev/docs/formats.md): GLB/KTX2, dotLottie, Rive, TSL/WGSL
- [Licence matrix](https://orbital-assets-proxy.jc-bose.workers.dev/docs/licenses.md): CC0 / MIT / MIT-0 / CC-BY + attribution rules

## Agents
- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://orbital-assets-proxy.jc-bose.workers.dev/openapi.json)
- [MCP server](https://orbital-assets-proxy.jc-bose.workers.dev/mcp): spec 2026-07-28, Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1
- [Agent card](https://orbital-assets-proxy.jc-bose.workers.dev/.well-known/agent-card.json)
- [MCP registry server.json](https://orbital-assets-proxy.jc-bose.workers.dev/.well-known/mcp/server.json)
